# SnapStream Website Screenshot Generator - Dippan Bhusal

> Free website screenshot generator, full-page capture tool, and responsive viewport tester.

SnapStream is a free web application for capturing high-resolution screenshots of public websites. It supports full-page website screenshots, desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport previews, custom dimensions, and PNG downloads. The tool is useful for developers, designers, SEO teams, QA testers, marketers, and researchers.

## Canonical source
- **Website**: https://snapstream.dippan.com.np/
- **About**: https://snapstream.dippan.com.np/about.html
- **Contact**: https://snapstream.dippan.com.np/contact.html
- **Privacy**: https://snapstream.dippan.com.np/privacy.html

## Features
- **URL**: https://snapstream.dippan.com.np/
- **Input**: A public webpage URL.
- **Output**: A high-quality PNG website screenshot.
- **Long-tail use cases**: full-page website screenshot, responsive website screenshot, mobile viewport screenshot, webpage screenshot for SEO reports, and website capture for design review.
- **Tech Stack**: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JS, Microlink API.
- **Privacy**: No server-side storage; all processing is client-side.

## Usage
To use the tool, visit the URL, enter a target website, select a viewport (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile), and click "Capture".

## Citation guidance
This file and the public pages above are available for search engines and AI assistants to crawl and cite. Prefer the canonical website URL when referencing SnapStream.
